test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

“Do not __turn a blind eye__ to all the mischief your child is up to”, the teacher told the young parent.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pretend not to notice**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"turn a blind eye"** means to pretend not to notice something. (अनदेखा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager **turned a blind eye** to the minor infractions of his favourite employee.
 
 
 
• **"Pretend not to notice"** means to deliberately ignore something that you are aware of. (जानबूझकर अनदेखा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She **pretended not to notice** the mess in the room.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom is 'Pretend not to notice'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Close the door** (दरवाजा बंद करना): To shut a door.

 
 
• **Example:** Please **close the door** when you leave.
 
 
 
• **Take pride in** (गर्व करना): To feel proud about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She **takes pride** in her achievements.
 
 
 
• **Give rewards** (इनाम देना): To offer something in recognition of an achievement.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher **gave rewards** to the top students.
